shape_hint: A thick flat round washer: disc with a concentric through-hole, flat on both faces, noticeably thicker than a normal washer (s about 0.33-0.5 x thread diameter) and with an outside diameter about 2.2-3 x the thread diameter.

role_map.d_nom_note: thread size M of the bolt (washer is used with bolts and heavy spring/clamping sleeves)

notes: DIN 7349 is the heavy washer for bolts used with heavy clamping sleeves (DIN 1481); it has no ISO equivalent and its current validity was not checked against the original. Only nominal values are published (tolerances not found in 3 sources). DIN 6340 (washers for clamping devices, quenched and tempered) was examined and rejected: the public tables disagree (M10 d2 26 vs 28, M12/M36 d1 differences). fasteners.eu, boltport and torqbolt carry one and the same table.

verification.checks_done: Live re-fetch of fasteners.eu, boltport, globalfastener, schrauben-lexikon (torqbolt from producer raw copy, compared equal to fasteners.eu on all 15 rows). Matrix 15 sizes x (d1,d2,s) x 5 pages. All 12 kept rows (M3,M4,M5,M6,M8,M10,M12,M16,M18,M20,M22,M27) x 3 cols = 36 cells identical in fe-cluster, gf and sl (3 clusters each; no dissent). Dropped rows confirmed: M14, M24 (only fe-cluster + gf), M30 (d2 68 in fe-cluster + gf, 69 in sl). Headers: fe 'd1 / d2 / s', gf 'Nominal Diameter d / dc / h' + 'For bolt diameter', sl 'd1 / d2 / h'. Physical sanity: d1,d2,s monotone, d2/d1 2.1-2.8, d1 > thread dia.
problems: Every kept cell has exactly 3 clusters under the STRICT reading (fe-cluster, gf, sl); no spare source.

globalfastener's hole column is headed only 'Nominal Diameter d' (no '1'); read as hole diameter because values (3.2, 4.3, ...) equal the fasteners.eu/schrauben-lexikon d1 and a separate 'For bolt diameter' row carries the thread size; row key M is read from that row, not inferred.
DIN 7349 is a withdrawn-style German standard (no ISO equivalent); only nominal values exist in all sources, no tolerances.
Alternatives (DIN 6340) correctly rejected by producer: not re-verified here (not part of the record).

standard_full: DIN 7349 (heavy plain washers for bolts with heavy clamping/spring sleeves; no ISO equivalent)
